name: Release cua-driver-rs v0.20.8
summary: Pre-release of the Qwen CUA Driver 0.20.8: prebuilt computer-use driver binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows plus SDK payloads.
description: GitHub pre-release of cua-driver-rs v0.20.8 in QwenLM/qwen-code: prebuilt Qwen CUA Driver binaries vendored under packages/cua-driver; macOS codesigned and notarized universal binary with QwenCuaDriver.app; unsigned Linux builds for x86_64 and arm64 (glibc 2.31); Windows UIAccess worker plus native SDK payload. The same workflow publishes the @qwen-code/cua-sdk and @qwen-code/node-repl-mcp npm packages.
contains: macOS: codesigned + notarized universal binary + QwenCuaDriver.app
Linux: unsigned x86_64 + arm64, glibc 2.31 floor
Windows: unsigned UIAccess worker + native SDK payload
released 14 Sep 2026; 21 assets; contributors yiliang114, LaZzyMan + 2
